name: Conjure Celestial
description: A spirit of the Upper Planes descends as a pillar of radiant light, a cylinder 10 feet wide and 40 feet tall that you can steer as you move. Each creature caught in its glow is bathed in healing light (4d12 + your modifier) or searing light (6d12 radiant damage on a failed Dexterity save, half on a success), once per turn.

name: Delayed Blast Fireball
description: Your fireball arrives as a small glowing bead that sits, gathering power — 12d6 fire damage, growing by 1d6 at the end of each of your turns — until it detonates in a 20-foot sphere, dealing the accumulated damage on a failed Dexterity save or half on a success.

name: Divine Word
description: You utter a single word of divine power that washes over creatures you choose. On a failed Charisma save, a creature is deafened, blinded, or stunned depending on how few hit points it has — and the weakest are simply killed, while extraplanar beings are hurled back to their home planes.

name: Etherealness
description: You step sideways into the Border Ethereal, where you can see and move through the world as a ghost, passing through solid matter while the material world can barely touch you. Cast with a higher slot, you can bring companions with you.

name: Finger of Death
description: A lance of negative energy wracks one creature, dealing 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage on a failed Constitution save or half on a success. A humanoid slain by it rises at the start of your next turn as a zombie forever under your command.

name: Fire Storm
description: A storm of roaring flame appears where you will it, built from up to ten contiguous 10-foot cubes you arrange like blocks. Every creature in the area makes a Dexterity save, taking 7d10 fire damage on a failure or half on a success, and unattended flammables ignite.

name: Forcecage
description: An immobile prison of invisible force springs up around your targets — either a barred cage 20 feet across or a solid box 10 feet across. Nothing physical or teleporting easily escapes it, and creatures trapped inside are cut off from the fight entirely. A creature inside that tries to leave by teleportation or interplanar travel must first succeed on a Charisma save.

name: Mirage Arcane
description: You rewrite the terrain of an area up to a mile square: the illusion has look, sound, smell, and even texture, so illusory ground can be walked on and illusory obstacles truly block the way. Structures and creatures keep their forms, but the land itself becomes whatever you imagine.

name: Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion
description: You conjure a shimmering door, 5 feet wide and 10 feet tall, leading to an extradimensional dwelling with a floor plan of your design — up to fifty contiguous 10-foot cubes, furnished and decorated as you choose. A staff of a hundred near-transparent servants attends all who enter, and food enough for a nine-course banquet for a hundred is served. Only you and creatures you designate can enter; you can open or close the door from within 30 feet, and while closed it is imperceptible. When the spell ends, anything left inside is expelled to the unoccupied spaces nearest the entrance.

name: Mordenkainen's Sword
description: A spectral sword of force appears within range, and as part of the casting you make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it — on a hit it takes 4d12 force damage plus your spellcasting ability modifier. On your later turns you can use a bonus action to move the sword up to 30 feet to a spot you can see and attack again, against the same target or a different one.

name: Plane Shift
description: Holding a forked metal rod attuned to your destination, you and up to eight willing creatures who link hands with you vanish to another plane of existence, arriving near the place you named.

name: Prismatic Spray
damage: 12d6 fire, acid, lightning, poison, or cold (determined per target by ray)
description: Eight dazzling rays of colored light fan from your hand across a 60-foot cone. Each creature rolls to learn its fate: most rays deal 12d6 damage of an element (fire, acid, lightning, poison, or cold) on a failed Dexterity save, while the indigo ray restrains and slowly petrifies, and the violet ray blinds or hurls the victim to another plane.

name: Project Image
description: You project a lifelike illusory double of yourself to any place you have seen, however distant, and see and hear through its senses. The image mimics your voice and manner perfectly but is intangible, vanishing if it takes any damage.

name: Regenerate
description: Your touch floods a creature with renewing life: it regains 4d8 + 15 hit points at once, then 1 hit point at the start of every turn for the hour. Severed limbs and organs regrow within minutes, and even a detached part held to the stump reattaches.

name: Resurrection
description: You call the soul of a creature dead no longer than a century back to its body, restoring it to life with full hit points and curing its poisons and mundane diseases. The ordeal is taxing: the revived creature takes mounting penalties that fade over long rests, and casting leaves you weakened until you rest.

name: Reverse Gravity
description: Gravity reverses in a 50-foot cylinder: everything unattached falls upward to the top of the area, taking falling damage when it strikes something, and hangs there until the spell ends and it all crashes down. Creatures who grab a fixed object can hold on with a Dexterity save.

name: Sequester
description: You hide a willing creature or an object beyond all finding: it becomes invisible, undetectable by divination, and — if a creature — falls into a timeless sleep that needs neither food nor air. A condition you set at casting ends the spell early.

name: Simulacrum
description: You sculpt a duplicate of a beast or humanoid out of snow or ice and breathe illusory life into it. The simulacrum has half the original's hit points and its abilities but no equipment, obeys you loyally, and cannot regain spell slots or grow stronger.

name: Symbol
description: You inscribe a hidden glyph of power on a surface or object, choosing its trigger and one dread effect — death (10d10 necrotic damage on a failed Constitution save), discord, fear, hopelessness, insanity, pain (a Constitution save), sleep, or stunning. Creatures within 60 feet when it triggers must save or suffer the chosen doom.

name: Teleport
description: In a word, you and up to eight willing creatures — or one object — vanish and reappear at a destination you name anywhere on the same plane. How well you know the destination decides the risk: a familiar teleportation circle is certain, while a vague description can scatter you or dump you somewhere dangerously similar. Off target, you land 2d12 miles away in a direction set by a 1d8 roll; a mishap deals 3d10 force damage to each traveler.
